_why: Read by the clean-code pre-commit hook (~/.config/git/hooks).
Only one setting is changed, and only for one reason.
`allowed_numbers` normally holds a handful of obviously-safe values.
The 33 added below are the coefficients of Bjorn Ottosson's OKLab
matrices and the sRGB transfer function, used in scripts/gen-themes.py
to derive every colour in src/web/styles/tokens.css. They are published
constants: 0.4122214708 is not a number wanting a name, it IS the name,
and hoisting each into its own identifier would make a matrix that reads
like the paper into eighteen lines that read like nothing.
Every other rule is left on, for every file. Nothing else is excluded.
